/bin/sh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='oval/util_test.go'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace('wantErr     bool\\n',''); s=s.replace('wantErr: false,\\n',''); s=s.replace('affected, notFixedYet, fixedIn, err := isOvalDefAffected(', 'affected, notFixedYet, fixState, fixedIn := isOvalDefAffected('); s=s.replace('if tt.wantErr "'!= (err != nil) {'"\\n\\t\\t\\tt.Errorf(\"[%d] err\\\\nexpected: %t\\\\n  actual: %s\\\\n\", i, tt.wantErr, err)\\n\\t\\t}\\n',''); s=s.replace('if tt.fixedIn "'!= fixedIn {'"','if fixState "'!= "" {'"\\n\\t\\t\\tt.Errorf(\"[%d] unexpected fixState: %s\", i, fixState)\\n\\t\\t}\\n\\t\\tif tt.fixedIn "'!= fixedIn {'"'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
go mod edit -require=github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary@v0.9.5
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=mod ./oval ./gost ./detector"
/bin/sh -lc 'gofmt -w gost/redhat.go oval/redhat_test.go && GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=mod ./oval ./gost ./detector'
/bin/sh -lc 'gofmt -w oval/redhat_test.go detector/detector.go gost/gost.go && GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=mod ./oval ./gost ./detector'
